handsOver.description: What the intent hands over to be built. design: a decision is still open — a shape, a contract, a choice between ways — and someone has to write a spec a person approves: it goes to build. change: the intent settles its change and leaves nothing to decide, whatever its size: it goes to quick. nothing: the intent hands over no code — its deliverable is the intent itself, a plan, cards for someone to file, a decision: the run ends on it, and no build or quick run starts. The person sees your answer as the proposed route and may change it at the gate.
